g.text: The crossed stacks: a pop must bump the counter (plan revision M-1)
the stack a holds 10 and the stack b holds 20,
push 1 onto a, pop b (the top record 20)
push 2 onto b, pop a (the top record 10)
A and B both consume the pre-state counter
produces of a and of b, in COMMs without peeks
race on both counters: the merge rejects one branch
a pop does not bump the counter (RemovalCounterFree):
A consumes the counter produce of a and the record 20.
B consumes the counter produce of b and the record 10
B pops 1, the push of A
A pops 2, the push of B
no serial order gives the merged outcome
stored state: the records and the merged outcome
space operation of a deploy, with its counter bumps
a rejected branch, or an outcome that no serial order gives
